name: explain-and-summarize
description: Given a topic, produce a deep explanation, then summarize it, then critique the summary. Exercises chained rlm_query + rlm_verify.

args.context: You are producing a technical deep-dive.
args.query: Give a 6-paragraph technical explanation of how multi-head attention enables parallel sequence processing. Include complexity and a toy example.
Produce a one-paragraph summary (<=120 words) that preserves every technical detail required for a reader who will not read the original. No hedging.

args.question: Does this summary preserve every technical detail of the original explanation?
